settings.title: Settings
settings.sessions: Work sessions before a long break
settings.sleep: When the computer sleeps or locks
settings.launch: Launch Tomatick when I log in
settings.shortcutsHelp: Work even when another application has focus. Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Escape cancels.
settings.shortcutNeedsModifier: Hold Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Cmd together with the key.
settings.launchFailed: Could not change launch at login:
settings.desktopProblems: Saved, but some desktop settings did not apply. See the System section.
settings.countdownPresetsHelp: One to six durations, separated by commas (for example 5, 10, 15, 30 or 1:30). They appear when you edit the countdown on the widget.
settings.alertsHelp: What happens when a phase ends. Sounds play through the app, independent of the system volume.
settings.bringToFront: Bring the widget to the front
settings.previewOverlayHint: Show the overlay with sample content. The timer is not touched.
settings.addFileHint: Use your own MP3, WAV or OGG file
settings.exercisesHelp: The app goes through this list in order, one entry per short break. A long break is split into several short ones and uses the list the same way.
settings.resetDone: Classic values loaded (25/5/15, 4 sessions). Save to apply them.
settings.errWork: Work must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} minutes.
settings.errShortBreak: Short break must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} minutes.
settings.errLongBreak: Long break must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} minutes.
settings.errSessions: Sessions must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
settings.errGoal: The daily goal must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
settings.errCountdown: The countdown must be between 0:01 and 23:59:59.
settings.errPresets: Quick choices must be one to {{max}} durations between 0:01 and 23:59:59, separated by commas.
settings.checkUpdatesHelp: Once a day, Tomatick asks GitHub for the latest release. This is the only network request the app makes. Nothing is downloaded or installed for you.
settings.license: Free and open source software, MIT license.
settings.updateFailed: Could not check for new versions.
